title: CREDO: Evidence-Conditioned Credit Assignment for Temporal Reasoning Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.01643v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) requires language model agents to retrieve evidence, select relevant facts, and perform multi-step temporal reasoning. However, the trajectory-level outcome signal in GRPO does not explicitly distinguish the quality of intermediate decisions: downstream failures can penalize useful evidence acquisition, while identical rewards in all-failed groups eliminate the relative outcome signal despite differences in intermediate progress. We propose Credit Redistribution with Evidence-Driven Opportunities (CREDO), which uses intermediate evidence to recover local supervision, including in all-failed groups, and determine where outcome supervision acts. CREDO assigns positive stage-level credit through comparisons among rollouts of the same question and uses retained answer overlap as an opportunity proxy to shift part of the outcome-policy weight toward reasoning and answering. translated_title: CREDO：面向时序推理智能体的基于证据条件的信用分配
translated_abstract: 时序知识图谱问答（TKGQA）要求语言模型智能体检索证据、选择相关事实并执行多步时序推理。然而，GRPO 中的轨迹级结果信号无法明确区分中间决策的质量：下游任务的失败可能会惩罚本应有用的证据获取行为，而在全部失败的组中，相同的奖励会消除相对结果信号，即便各次尝试在中间进度上存在差异。我们提出了基于证据驱动机会的信用再分配方法（CREDO），该方法利用中间证据来恢复局部监督信号（包括在全部失败的组中），并确定结果监督应作用于何处。CREDO 通过对同一问题的多个采样轨迹之间的比较来分配正向的阶段级信用，并将保留答案的重叠度作为机会代理，把部分结果策略的权重转移到推理和回答阶段。该框架...
tldr: 提出CREDO方法，通过利用中间证据恢复局部监督并进行阶段级信用再分配，解决了GRPO中轨迹级结果信号无法区分中间决策质量、且全失败组监督信号消失的问题。
en_tdlr: CREDO recovers local supervision from intermediate evidence and redistributes stage-level credit for temporal reasoning agents, addressing GRPO's failure to distinguish intermediate decision quality and the vanishing signal in all-failed groups.
